speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me; I understand you have developed fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in the color, clarity, or volume of your urine, or do you have pain when urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms persisted after the sinusitis treatment, have you noticed any blood in your urine, or have you experienced shaking chills or nausea? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis

Based on your history of fever and flank pain persisting after sinusitis treatment, combined with the rash that appeared during antibiotic use, I suspect this may be a severe urinary tract infection or a reaction to the medication.
